task.description: Hard gate: validate TEST-DESIGNER Step 3 output. Verify every MUST requirement (all 4 are MUST) has a runnable integration/unit test, no error.SkipZigTest on any MUST test, fixtures are isolated (per-test UUIDs, proper cleanup), tests are self-sufficient (connect to real PostgreSQL, no mocks/stubs). Also check: for the MIG-01 migration which adds a new table with CHECK constraints (status enum), a schema contract test exists per the anti-patterns doc TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR checklist (CHECK constraint -> schema contract test requirement).
acceptance_criteria: Every MUST requirement AC traced to a real, runnable test
No error.SkipZigTest on any MUST test
Schema contract test check for MIG-01 CHECK constraints

result.summary: Validated TEST-DESIGNER Step 3 output for DDL-05, MIG-01, MIG-02, MIG-03 (all MUST). All 4 MUST requirements trace every AC to a real, runnable test verified against actual source (not just spec claims): 10 unit tests in src/platform/ddl_namespace.zig (DDL-05 AC1-AC4, AC5 explicitly out-of-scope pending DDL-01 per accepted CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR scoping), 5 integration tests in tests/integration/platform_migrations_control_table_test.zig (MIG-01 AC2-AC5), and 8 integration tests in tests/integration/migration_fanout_test.zig (MIG-01 AC1-fanout, MIG-02 AC1-AC3, MIG-03 AC1/AC1b/AC2/AC3/AC5). Zero error.SkipZigTest in any of the three files (grep-confirmed). Fixture isolation confirmed: per-test UUIDs via std.testing.io.random / randomToken, no static/sequential IDs, unconditional defer cleanup on every fixture (tenants, control rows, advisory-lock holder connections); tools/lint_test_isolation.py tests/integration reports 0 BLOCKER on 139 files, and the 3 new test files do not appear in the isolation baseline (clean on merits, not suppressed). Self-sufficiency confirmed: all integration tests read BPM_TEST_DB_URL via portable_env.globalEnviron() and return a clear error.MissingTestDatabaseUrl if absent (no silent skip); DIRECTIVE T-1 satisfied (real bpm.pool.Pool / helpers.TestHarness against real PostgreSQL throughout, no mocks/stubs). Schema contract check for MIG-01s new status CHECK constraint (migrations/1144_platform_migrations_control_table.sql, CHECK (status IN (pending, done, failed))): no dedicated tests/integration/schema_contracts/ file exists, but platform_migrations_control_table_test.zig genuinely exercises accept (pending/done/failed inserted successfully across 4 test blocks) and reject (status_check_constraint_rejects_unknown_value inserts bogus, asserts error.ServerError i.e. 23514, and asserts 0 rows survive) coverage for this exact constraint -- satisfies the either-location allowance in this checks instructions. Fail-first confirmed: TEST-DESIGNER handoff (step-03-test-designer.json) documents a live fail-first run for the one newly added test (TC-MIG-01-AC1-fanout) -- temporarily broke the seed status literal, watched the new test go red with TestExpectedPendingStatus while the other 7 stayed green, then reverted. No credentials/secrets/production URLs hardcoded in any test file (grep-confirmed); all SQL uses / parameterised placeholders, zero string concatenation into SQL. Build verification: ran all 3 targeted steps live with BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5433/bpm_test and BPM_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5432/bpm_dev (overriding a stale ambient env var) -- zig build test-ddl-namespace exit 0 (Build Summary: 3/3 steps succeeded; 10/10 tests passed), zig build test-integration-mig01 exit 0 (6/6 steps succeeded; 5/5 tests passed), zig build test-integration-mig02-mig03 exit 0 (6/6 steps succeeded; 8/8 tests passed) -- all confirmed via --summary all rather than trusting bare exit code alone, per the anti-patterns doc caution against trusting stray output. Pipeline checks (7-11) not applicable: none of the 4 requirements involve a sequential UI action (DDL-05 is a pure backend predicate; MIG-01/02/03 are DB schema + backend fanout logic with no UI surface), so no pl.step()/PIPELINE-<slug>.md gap exists to flag. tools/lint_handoffs.py exits with 0 BLOCKER, 0 new MAJOR (2510 handoffs checked, only pre-existing acknowledged baseline entries and 1 pre-existing MINOR).
